purpose: Field adaptation experiment; not independent all-crop accuracy certification

sources.name: Diseases of maize in the field
sources.author: Hamish Craze

sources.name: Cropped-PlantDoc
sources.authors: Davinder Singh, Naman Jain, Pranjali Jain, Pratik Kayal, Sudhakar Kumawat, Nipun Batra

protected_benchmark: 40 original maize photographs and their near matches/inferred groups excluded
near_duplicate_filter: 64-bit horizontal dHash, Hamming distance <=4; conservative heuristic, not proof of independence
grouping: University inferred leaf IDs/minute timestamps where available; other IDs are filename fallbacks. No verified plant/session separation.
field_gaps: Tomato Target Spot, Spider mites, and healthy bell pepper: PlantVillage replay only. Unverified/mixed-crop PlantDoc folders excluded.

manual_content_review.method: Manual contact-sheet content review before the final completed experiment. No disease labels reassigned. An earlier incomplete attempt was aborted for an additional collage exclusion. Not expert disease verification.

excluded_folders.train/Bell_pepper leaf: Mixed crop identities including apparent black-pepper spikes/leaves. Entire healthy-bell-pepper folder excluded pending expert crop verification.
excluded_folders.test/Bell_pepper leaf: Same mixed-crop concern; use PlantVillage replay for healthy bell pepper only.

pretrained_overlap: Publisher v1.1 already trained on PlantVillage and Cropped-PlantDoc. University dataset is not declared but web reuse/undisclosed overlap cannot be excluded.
alternative_review: PlantWild/v2 investigated; not selected for this run: BY-NC-ND terms, large archives and additional taxonomy/overlap review required.
